decisions.reason: The 15-day express option overlaps with faster express programs and has only been mentioned rather than promoted, so there is moderate risk it is pruned, but low keeping costs justify retaining it as an option for now.
The 72-hour express option remains a low-cost service extension with unresolved demand, so it is kept as an option despite limited promotion.
Having its own page indicates active support and some revealed value, so it is kept with low drop probability.
The digital platform is a strategically important option with high upside and unresolved uncertainty, so it is strongly kept.
The fire and smoke protection door has gained more website prominence, suggesting positive signals, so it is kept.
